mapper.sql: id, user_id, label, path, icon, content, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM resume WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume (id, user_id, label, path, icon, content, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{label}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{content}, #{version}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET label = #{label}, path = #{path}, icon = #{icon}, content = #{content}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
